title: Targeting the gut-ovarian axis: Scutellaria baicalensis improves polycystic ovary syndrome by modulating gut microbiota composition and inhibiting the LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Pan, Zhengxiu; Zhang, Caili; Chu, Qiangqiang; Chen, Mingwei; Hui, Cancan; Wang, Tianjuan; Han, Maozhen; Deng, Datong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药黄芩通过调节肠道菌群和LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB通路改善多囊卵巢综合征，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a chronic inflammatory disease caused by a combination of genetic, environmental, and gut microbiota factors. Western medicines can improve ovulation rates, but are linked with reduced pregnancy success and side effects. Scutellaria baicalensis (BAL) is a famous anti-inflammatory Chinese herb, which has therapeutic effects for PCOS; however, the mechanism remains unclear. This study integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and animal experiments to investigate the mechanisms by which BAL improves gut microbiota and intestinal inflammation in a rat PCOS model. We identified 36 active components of BAL, including wogonin, baicalein, and oroxylin A, along with 145 potential targets, such as TNF, IL-6, and AKT1, and network analysis revealed that TNF, IL-6, and AKT1 occupied central positions. Enrichment analyses indicated that BAL may exert its therapeutic effects by modulating the NF-kappaB and Toll-like receptor signaling pathways. Molecular docking results demonstrated strong binding affinities between BAL's primary active components and the core targets TNF, AKT1, and IL-6. BAL experiments in PCOS rats showed that it restored gut microbiota balance. These results showed that BAL inhibits the LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway and downregulates PI3K and p-Akt/Akt protein expression in ovarian tissue. BAL also improved reproductive metabolic abnormalities, intestinal inflammation, and dysbiosis. Our study suggests that BAL inhibits the LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway via the gut-ovarian axis, regulating gut microbial composition and alleviating inflammatory states. This may be a mechanism for the therapeutic efficacy of BAL for PCOS and a novel therapeutic strategy for the clinical management of polycystic ovary syndrome.IMPORTANCEPCOS affects women of reproductive age. Current clinical treatment strategies still face limitations in efficacy and long-term side effects. This study employs network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation to elucidate the mechanism by which the traditional Chinese medicine BAL improves PCOS. We found that BAL modulates gut microbiota in a PCOS rat model, significantly increasing the probiotic genus Phocaeicola. This change correlates with reduced serum LPS levels and alleviated ovarian inflammation. Experiments confirm that BAL alleviates local ovarian inflammation and insulin resistance by inhibiting the LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby improving PCOS pathological manifestations. This study reveals new mechanisms of BAL in treating PCOS and highlights the potential bridging role of probiotics like Phocaeicola. It also provides experimental evidence and theoretical support for integrated Chinese and Western medicine treatment strategies based on regulating gut microbiota.
abstract_zh:
多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种由遗传、环境和肠道菌群因素共同引起的慢性炎症性疾病。西药可改善排卵率，但伴随妊娠成功率降低及副作用。黄芩（BAL）是一种著名的抗炎中药，对PCOS具有治疗作用，但其机制尚不明确。本研究整合网络药理学、分子对接和动物实验，探讨BAL改善大鼠PCOS模型中肠道菌群和肠道炎症的机制。我们鉴定了BAL的36种活性成分，包括汉黄芩素（wogonin）、黄芩素（baicalein）和去甲汉黄芩素（oroxylin A），以及145个潜在靶点，如TNF、IL-6和AKT1，网络分析显示TNF、IL-6和AKT1占据核心位置。富集分析表明，BAL可能通过调节NF-kappaB和Toll样受体信号通路发挥其治疗作用。分子对接结果显示，BAL的主要活性成分与核心靶点TNF、AKT1和IL-6之间具有强结合亲和力。在PCOS大鼠中的BAL实验表明，它恢复了肠道菌群平衡。这些结果表明，BAL抑制LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB通路，并下调卵巢组织中PI3K和p-Akt/Akt蛋白表达。BAL还改善了生殖代谢异常、肠道炎症和菌群失调。我们的研究表明，BAL通过肠-卵巢轴抑制LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB通路，调节肠道微生物组成并缓解炎症状态。这可能是BAL对PCOS治疗效果的机制，也是多囊卵巢综合征临床管理的一种新型治疗策略。

重要性 PCOS影响育龄期女性。当前临床治疗策略在疗效和长期副作用方面仍面临局限。本研究采用网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证，阐明中药BAL改善PCOS的机制。我们发现BAL调节PCOS大鼠模型中的肠道菌群，显著增加益生菌属Phocaeicola。这一变化与血清LPS水平降低和卵巢炎症缓解相关。实验证实，BAL通过抑制LPS/TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路，减轻局部卵巢炎症和胰岛素抵抗，从而改善PCOS病理表现。本研究揭示了BAL治疗PCOS的新机制，并强调了Phocaeicola等益生菌的潜在桥梁作用，同时为基于调节肠道菌群的中西医结合治疗策略提供了实验证据和理论支持。
